tests.title: runs against the reference build of commit 946fcce0 configured with --disable-x86asm
matches native -vf noformat rawvideo and framecrc, or refuses native's storage-less pick by name, across formats sizes and time scopes
matches native -filter_complex noformat branches through the media graph and the timed producer and pull schedulers
matches native noformat frame by frame through replay streams and activation actors, or refuses the pick by name
negotiates every accepted source as native does for noformat lists and refuses picks without storage by name on every path
refuses noformat forms outside the scope before opening outputs on every backend, where native accepts or rejects them

unsupported: color_spaces, color_ranges and alpha_modes lists (native accepts; refused before output)
duplicated pixel formats (native accepts; refused as format refuses them)
pixel formats parseFilterPixelFormat does not declare, yuvj formats and high-bit-depth formats included
native picks without frame storage (yuvj420p, yuyv422, yuvj444p, pal8, yuva422p, ...) and conversions into legacy yuvj formats: refused by name before output by the shared negotiators
negate chains on the actor and timed paths (negate is not flagged there)

proposedContracts.name: matches native -vf noformat rawvideo and framecrc, or refuses native's storage-less pick by name, across formats sizes and time scopes
proposedContracts.scope: 14 storage sources at 1x1/2x2/5x3/7x5/8x6/17x9; noformat=<source>, noformat=pix_fmts=<source>|<other>, noformat=yuv420p,negate, format=rgb24,noformat=rgb24, noformat=gray|yuv420p,hflip; rawvideo/framecrc; -ss/-t; -cpuflags 0 and scalar; storage-less picks refused by name.

proposedContracts.name: matches native -filter_complex noformat branches through the media graph and the timed producer and pull schedulers
proposedContracts.scope: split graphs at 1x1/5x3/17x9 through the media, timed producer and timed pull backends, rawvideo/framecrc, -ss/-frames:v.

proposedContracts.name: matches native noformat frame by frame through replay streams and activation actors, or refuses the pick by name
proposedContracts.scope: createReplayVideoExecution and createFrameActors frame by frame at 1x1/5x3/17x9.

proposedContracts.name: negotiates every accepted source as native does for noformat lists and refuses picks without storage by name on every path
proposedContracts.scope: tests/helpers/video-negotiation-cases.ts over 17 sources for four lists plus each source excluding itself; outcomes pinned.

proposedContracts.name: refuses noformat forms outside the scope before opening outputs on every backend, where native accepts or rejects them
proposedContracts.scope: duplicates, color lists, undeclared names, enable= and unknown names refused before output on the media, producer and pull backends.

notes: Sandbox Node 22.23.5 was too old for bootstrap (Node 24+ required); Node 24.22.3 was installed from the npm 'node' package into the scratchpad and put first on PATH.
Setup durations: bootstrap npm 9.9 s, submodule 9.7 s, reference build about 4 min (bootstrap total 4m26s); baseline typecheck+lint+boundaries+registry test 1m25s, all green (registry test 8/8).

Native's pick depends on the whole graph: input -ss adds trim and changes nv12/nv21 with noformat=yuv420p,negate from the source format to yuvj420p. The tests read showinfo from the same native command that produces the compared bytes; EdgeFFmpeg matches both picks.
No linux-gated cases: noformat does no arithmetic and the conversions it causes are integer swscale under -cpuflags 0/scalar.
Differential file runs in about 26 s with --maxWorkers=1 on 4 vCPUs.
